name: connection
title: Connection
description: Connections to services (a model provider's, a tool server's), read, never managed. ConnectionList of ConnectionListItem: a row a connection, its name cut to a line and its status under it, a button that shows it (aria-current while shown); loading, its rows' shapes; none, labels.empty or the app's empty (a filter's "No match"); not fetched (error), why and Retry. Filtering and pages are the app's around it. ConnectionStatus: available, rejected, unknown or off, told by its mark's shape (a dot, a diamond, a ring, a bar) and its word, when it was checked and, too old to go by, "May be out of date"; why under it. ConnectionDetails (none chosen, loading, unavailable, or its parts): ConnectionDetailsHeader (its name whole and its status), ConnectionNotice (what needs the reader, e.g. to enter its key again, and the app's link to how), ConnectionDetailsField, ConnectionTarget (an address in mono on a line, a button showing it whole where it is cut short, one copying it) and ConnectionCredential (the app's masked summary, with a lock: no way to show or enter it).
